apps.localizedDescription: Start the task you already know you need to do. When your brain wants novelty, tap one button for a deliberately tiny reset, then return to the task. No lists, streaks, accounts, ads or analytics.

versions.localizedDescription: Adds V2 refined sensory and cognitive resets while preserving every V1 reset for direct comparison. Choose V1, V2 or Alternate in Settings.
